Each request's outer structure is already in preferred framing, so C(n) differs from the request only by the emptied unprotected map, whichever CBOR implementation re-emits it.

what_would_refute_it: Any measured outcome, refusal text or data-hash that differs from a row here. A refusal never carries a data-hash; cn_sha256 is the oracle's rebuilt object for every row and is a commitment only where a receipt exists.
